lore_family_photo.name: Photograph annotation
lore_family_photo.text:
14 October 1987. Mara, Daniel, and little Elsie Vale, outside their new home.

On the back, another hand has written: Three people. Remember that. Even if you hear four.

lore_keeper_journal.name: Keeper's private journal
lore_keeper_journal.text:
17 October 1987.
Mara called me from the kitchen. At the same moment, her voice asked to be let out of the bedroom. She was standing beside me.

I am the caretaker. Keeping them safe is my responsibility. But which voice should I believe?

lore_maintenance.name: Damaged maintenance report
lore_maintenance.text:
16 October 1987. North exit relay unreliable. Replacement fuse stored here; kitchen box feeds the dining lockbox.

18 October: Fuse removed by caretaker. Pry bar secured behind the household count wheels. Exit key boarded into bedside cabinet. No authorization from the family.

lore_missing_notice.name: Missing-person notice
lore_missing_notice.text:
23 October 1987. MISSING: Mara Vale, Daniel Vale, Elsie Vale, age seven. Last seen at their home on 19 October.

Caretaker questioned; released without charges. No departure witnessed. No bodies recovered. Please report sightings rather than entering the property.

lore_unsent_letter.name: Unsent letter
lore_unsent_letter.text:
18 October 1987. Dear Ruth,
The Keeper says the voices are dangerous. He has locked our way out for our own protection. Daniel asked for the key. The Keeper would not look at him.

If this reaches you, come in daylight. Elsie keeps asking why we must prove we are ourselves. — Mara

lore_observation_log.name: Strange observation log
lore_observation_log.text:
19 October, 21:10. Three voices pleaded at the north door. I told myself they were copies.
20 October, 04:00. Rooms empty. Supper untouched. Elsie's ribbon left behind.
20 October, 04:12. The voices repeated the same pleas, word for word.

The thing may remember us. A familiar face is not proof of a person.

lore_keeper_confession.name: Final caretaker confession
lore_keeper_confession.text:
2 November 1987.
I locked them inside. I hid the key. I heard a frightened child and decided she was an imitation. They vanished before I returned.

I called it containment because I could not call it my fault. The instructions and tally will undo my locks. Take the records outside. Do not let my fear become the only account.

lore_hidden_record.name: Folded containment record
lore_hidden_record.text:
An undated page folded beside the washroom basin.

Do not follow a voice alone. Do not imprison someone because you fear what they resemble. Keep dates. Keep names. Leave a route out.

Below this, in the Keeper's hand: It wears my coat now. Or I have begun to recognize myself in it.

events.caption: A distant cabinet creaks. For a moment, someone occupies the doorway.
The relay answers. Somewhere beyond it, three quiet knocks.
A coat-shaped shadow watches from the passage. It is gone before you can name it.
A chair shifts. The Keeper locked away the tool that could have freed them.
Scratched into the cabinet: LET US OUT. A child's ribbon lies beneath the boards.
The records are yours to carry. Beyond the north door, a familiar outline waits.

intro.title: THE KEEPER'S SECRET
intro.text: In October 1987, the Vale family disappeared inside this house. Their caretaker left records. Nobody found a way to explain them.

intro.title: THE INVESTIGATION
intro.text: You came to recover those records and learn why the family never left. Tonight, the abandoned house has an open entrance.

intro.title: ARRIVAL
intro.text: The entrance closes behind you. Somewhere in the house, three quiet knocks answer your footsteps. The north exit is locked.

intro.title: INSIDE
intro.text: A flashlight waits on the foyer console. Search the rooms, read the Keeper's instructions, and find a way out. Optional records may tell you what happened.

escape.title: ESCAPE
escape.text: The north door opens. Cold air replaces the stillness of the house. You keep walking.

escape.title: BEHIND YOU
escape.text: You heard something in there. You found the Keeper's locks and undid them. You still do not know whom they were meant to keep safe.

escape.title: THE EMPTY HOUSE
escape.text: The Vale family remains missing. Another account joins the rumors: yours. For tonight, surviving is enough.

escape.title: OUTSIDE
escape.text: You leave the property alive. Somewhere behind the closed door, footsteps continue.

truth.title: THE TRUTH
truth.text: The dates agree. The Keeper took the fuse, secured the pry bar, and hid the key while the family was still inside.

truth.title: CONTAINMENT
truth.text: Something imitated their voices. Fear made the Keeper distrust the real pleas as well. He locked the family in, then called their disappearance protection.

truth.title: THE FIGURE
truth.text: The presence remembers voices and shapes. Whether the figure is the Keeper, one of the missing, or an echo remains uncertain. His records cannot answer that.

truth.title: WITNESS
truth.text: You carry the evidence outside. Mara, Daniel, and Elsie have names again, and the Keeper's secret has witnesses. The house loses its only account.
